2. About Sthitha & Scope of Services

The website provides informational, educational, and introductory technical resources regarding our three core operational pillars:

  • Sthitha Exodia: Our initiative exploring post-quantum cryptographic discovery, quantum risk awareness, inventory analysis, and migration planning for enterprise systems.
  • Sthitha Academy: Structured quantum computing courses, educational modules, and bilingual learning resources (including Malayalam-language education) designed for beginners, developers, and researchers.
  • Research & Innovation: Technical publications, explainers, algorithmic studies, and quantum machine learning explorations.

Nothing on this website constitutes a formal offer, binding commercial proposal, or cryptographic service level agreement (SLA) unless expressly executed in a separate, written enterprise Master Services Agreement (MSA) signed by authorized signatories of Sthitha Quantum Innovations Pvt Ltd.
